# HexPiece 3.9.9

The Itsumade's kit, part 4: **N Hellish Teleport** (as a human). **Not tested in game yet:** the build and every test suite pass, and
the menu (both screen sizes), the summoning circle (flat and on steps, as it forms), the black-flame pillar, the flames swallowing a
body and the new clip were rendered and checked off-game.

## The menu
N opens a near-black menu with a great dark pentagram turning slowly behind it and embers rising. It holds **three gates**, each a card
with its own little circle (lit, with cyan and pink fire round it, when bound; dead and grey when empty), its numeral, its name and where
it is:
- **BIND HERE** on an empty gate keeps the spot where you stand (it is named Gate I, II or III).
- **OPEN** on a bound gate opens it (the menu closes).
- **NAME** renames it: type straight into the card (letters, digits, spaces, dashes), Enter keeps it, Esc does not.
- **MOVE** binds it again where you stand; **CLEAR** empties it.
The gates are kept with you through death. A gate in another world cannot be opened from this one (the card says so), and while the
gates are closed (60 s after one opened) the menu counts the seconds down. The menu does not pause the game.

## Opening a gate
Your hands go down to the ground and a **summoning circle forms under you and at the gate at the same time**, over 10 seconds: a very
dark navy-purple disc wells up, its outer circle is traced round, a band of pale lavender runes is written round it one by one, the
star is drawn point to point (its points fill deep blue, a pink mark in each), and cyan fire with pink edges licks up all round it. It
lies on the ground as the ground is: every piece on the top of the block under it, its lines climbing the face of a step. Then
everything standing on yours (you, other players, mobs, dropped items) is swallowed by black flames drawn into its middle, a **pillar of
black flames blasts up into the sky** from it, a **beam of them falls out of the sky** onto the other circle, and everything taken
stands there, where it stood on yours, as the flames peel off it. Both circles fade.

Everything is Minecraft's own sounds (the respawn anchor, the portal, the end portal opening).
